JUDGEMENT. No Phase 3 is registered. The obesity dose-finding Phase 2 (NCT07184632) has primary completion 2026-12-14, and the Phase 2 comparing dose escalation regimens (NCT07639021) is expected to read out in Q1 2027 (6-K 0000353278-26-000023; the registry, updated 2026-09-16, now gives primary completion 2027-06-14), so a Phase 3 starts in 2027, most likely the second half once the escalation is chosen. Analogues: eloralintide went from its first Phase 3 start (NCT07282600, 2025-12-15) to its first full year in the book, 2030, in about four years; Novo's own zenagamtide from the start of AMAZE 1 (NCT07339423, 2026-02-24) to its first full year in the book, 2031, in about five. H2 2027 plus four years is late 2031, so 2032 is the first full year on sale
